result.instructions: Tools for Thought Industries, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which learners finished a course this week?"; "Show me the assessment attempts for one learner and their scores."; "Enroll these three users in the onboarding course.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Thought Industries data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run thoughtindustries_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run thoughtindustries_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run thoughtindustries_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. thoughtindustries_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_ping
tools.title: Check the connection
tools.description: Verify the API key and academy subdomain. Returns { valid: true } when the key works. REST: GET /ping.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_get_job
tools.title: Get an async job
tools.description: Poll an asynchronous job (for example a bulk user import or course creation). Status is pending, processing, complete, or failed. REST: GET /jobs/{id}.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the call that started the job.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users of one role (learners by default), cursor-paginated. There is no email or client filter on this list: use thoughtindustries_get_user for one user. REST: GET /users.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's pageInfo.cursor. Omit for the first page. Do not change it.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user's full profile and enrollment details. The id can be the user UUID, email address, or externalCustomerId. REST: GET /users/{id}.

user_id.description: User UUID, email address, or externalCustomerId.

tools.title: List content
tools.description: Browse or search published content. Without types, only courses and learning paths are returned. To find content by SKU, pass query as sku:"<sku>". REST: GET /content.

query.description: Thought Industries search query, Type:Value form, for example sku:"ABC-1" or tags:"Premium".
